question: If cos 24° = (m)/(n) , then the value of (cosec 24° - cos 66°) is:
solution: __Shortcut Trick__ Given, cos 24° = m / n Using complementary angles, cos 66° = cos(90° − 24°) = sin 24° Expression: cosec 24° − cos 66° = 1 / sin 24° − sin 24° = (1 − sin² 24°) / sin 24° = cos² 24° / sin 24° Since cos 24° = m / n, we get sin 24° = √(1 − m²/n²) = √(n² − m²) / n ⇒ Value = (m / n)² × [n / √(n² − m²)] = m² / [n√(n² − m²)] **∴ The correct answer is m² / [n√(n² − m²)].**
